verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a SaaS work-management platform like Wrike, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions choosing a storage region or data residency. The closest item, customer-managed encryption keys, is an adjacent privacy control and does not let the user choose where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
